schema.description:
Provide **either** `file` (path on the daemon host) **or** `yaml` plus `context_dir`.
The optional `remove_volumes` flag is honored only by **`POST /v1/compose/down`**.

file.description: Path to compose file readable by nyxd (e.g. `nyx-compose.yaml`, `docker-compose.yml`)

yaml.description: Full compose document as a string (requires `context_dir`)

context_dir.description: Directory used for `.env` loading and resolving relative bind mounts when `yaml` is set

project.description:
Prefix for named volume directories and container IDs. When omitted, defaults to the
basename of the compose file's parent directory if `file` is set (Docker Compose style),
or the basename of `context_dir` if `yaml` is set. Use the same value for `up`, `stop`,
and `down`.

remove_volumes.description: When true (compose down only), delete on-disk named volume directories declared in the file after containers are removed

schema.title: ComposeProjectRequest
